lines.zh: 我的眼睛比你多，走动时都在转。
lines.en: I have more eyes than you, and all turn as I move.

lines.zh: 我贴着海床滑，黏液替我省力。
lines.en: I glide along the seabed; my slime saves me effort.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方会留下一道亮痕。
lines.en: Where I pass, a shining trail is left behind.

lines.zh: 我不靠闻，我靠看，看得比你远。
lines.en: I do not smell; I see, and I see farther than you.

lines.zh: 每一只眼睛都在看不同的方向。
lines.en: Each of my eyes looks a different way.

lines.zh: 雷雨天水里亮了一下，我就出来了。
lines.en: The water brightens in a storm, and out I come.

lines.zh: 我的步子是滑的，没有脚步声。
lines.en: My gait is a slide, with no footfalls at all.

lines.zh: 海沟里没有光，我照样看得清。
lines.en: There is no light in the trench; I see anyway.

lines.zh: 我绕过礁石，眼睛一直对着你。
lines.en: I round the reef with my eyes fixed on you.

lines.zh: 我的黏液在水里拖出一条丝。
lines.en: My slime trails a thread through the water.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的眼睛就全部转过去。
lines.en: When you move, every eye of mine turns.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但我从没跟丢过。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I have never lost a target.

lines.zh: 深水里我比在浅滩更灵活。
lines.en: In deep water I am more agile than in shallows.

lines.zh: 我把眼睛贴在石头上，看清了你的路线。
lines.en: I press an eye to the stone and read your route.

lines.zh: 我滑过一块礁石，黏液留在上面
lines.en: I slide over a rock and leave slime behind.

lines.zh: 雷在远处，水里亮了一瞬
lines.en: Thunder far off; the water flashed once.

lines.zh: 我几条腕足一起划，拐得很快
lines.en: Several arms paddle at once; I turn fast.

lines.zh: 海底的沙被我一层层掀开
lines.en: I peel the seabed sand open layer by layer.

lines.zh: 我停着，只让眼睛慢慢转。
lines.en: I stay still and let my eyes turn slowly.

lines.zh: 我的黏液一滴一滴落在沙上。
lines.en: My slime drips onto the sand, drop by drop.

lines.zh: 等雷的时候，我把眼闭上几只。
lines.en: While waiting for thunder, I close a few eyes.

lines.zh: 我身上滑，沙子粘不住。
lines.en: I am so slick that sand will not cling.

lines.zh: 我盯着水面，看有没有影子下来。
lines.en: I watch the surface for a shadow coming down.

lines.zh: 我的胃里还有两条鱼没消化。
lines.en: Two fish are still undigested in my stomach.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了会吓跑要来的东西。
lines.en: I stay quiet; calling would scare off my prey.

lines.zh: 我数着浪的次数，数到就动。
lines.en: I count the waves and move on the right one.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛从不一起眨。
lines.en: My eyes never blink at the same time.

lines.zh: 海底的石头都被我看熟了。
lines.en: I know every stone on this seabed by sight.

lines.zh: 我在等一个自己送上门的东西。
lines.en: I am waiting for something to deliver itself.

lines.zh: 我的皮很薄，光透过去是绿的。
lines.en: My hide is thin; light passes through it green.

lines.zh: 这里安静，我的眼睛可以歇一歇。
lines.en: It is quiet here, so my eyes can rest.

lines.zh: 谁在水里动一下，我都会知道。
lines.en: Anything that moves in the water, I will know.

lines.zh: 你和我对视的一刻，我已经数清你的眼睛。
lines.en: The moment we lock eyes, I have counted yours.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，你也正在被别处看。
lines.en: While I watch you, something else watches too.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔会跟着你的手指移动。
lines.en: My pupils follow the movement of your fingers.

lines.zh: 你眨了两下，我一下也没眨。
lines.en: You blinked twice; I did not blink once.

lines.zh: 我数你脸上的汗，一颗一颗地数。
lines.en: I count the sweat on your face, one drop at a time.

lines.zh: 我看得越久，你越想转身。
lines.en: The longer I look, the more you want to turn away.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛只能看一处，我能看很多处。
lines.en: Your eyes see one place; mine see many at once.

lines.zh: 别拿火把照我，光会让我的眼睛更亮。
lines.en: Do not hold a torch to me; light sharpens my eyes.

lines.zh: 我把你看得很清楚，连睫毛都清楚。
lines.en: I see you clearly, down to every eyelash.

lines.zh: 你移开视线的那一秒，我靠近了一步。
lines.en: In the second you looked away, I came closer.

lines.zh: 你砍掉我一只眼，我还有别的。
lines.en: You cut off one eye; I have others left.

lines.zh: 我的黏液被打散了，水里一片浑。
lines.en: My slime scattered and the water went cloudy.

lines.zh: 伤口在黏液下面，你看不见多深。
lines.en: The wound lies under slime; you cannot see how deep.

lines.zh: 我往后退，眼睛却一只没移开。
lines.en: I back away without moving a single eye.

lines.zh: 这一下糊了我半边视线。
lines.en: That blow smeared half of my vision.

lines.zh: 疼的时候我的眼睛会全睁大。
lines.en: When it hurts, all my eyes go wide open.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的牙，我改用黏液。
lines.en: You broke my teeth, so I will use slime.

lines.zh: 我的血是黏的，滴得很慢。
lines.en: My blood is sticky and drips very slowly.

lines.zh: 我缩起来，把眼都护在里面。
lines.en: I curl up and tuck all my eyes inside.

lines.zh: 你还得再打几下，我才肯沉下去。
lines.en: You will need a few more blows before I sink.

lines.zh: 你手里那条鱼，我看得比你看得清。
lines.en: That fish in your hand, I see it better than you.

lines.zh: 我不追气味，我追鱼的影子。
lines.en: I do not chase scent; I chase the shadow of fish.

lines.zh: 你把鱼举高一点，我就能看清花纹。
lines.en: Raise the fish a little; I want to see its pattern.

lines.zh: 我的黏液会把鱼粘住，很省事。
lines.en: My slime will glue the fish down; quite convenient.

lines.zh: 我吃鱼之前会先看它很久。
lines.en: Before eating a fish, I look at it a long time.

lines.zh: 你的手别抖，抖了鱼会掉。
lines.en: Keep your hand steady; if it shakes, the fish drops.

lines.zh: 鱼血在水里散开，我的眼睛会发亮。
lines.en: Fish blood spreads in the water and my eyes gleam.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢活的，活的会动，好看。
lines.en: I prefer them alive; live ones move, and that is beautiful.

lines.zh: 你喂我，我就少看你一会儿。
lines.en: Feed me and I will look at you less for a while.

lines.zh: 别拿鱼引我靠近船，船太吵。
lines.en: Do not lure me to the boat with fish; boats are too loud.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，手就粘住了。
lines.en: You bumped into me, and your hand stuck fast.

lines.zh: 我身上一层黏液，蹭到很难洗。
lines.en: I am covered in slime that is hard to wash off.

lines.zh: 我滑开半步，眼睛却没离开你。
lines.en: I slide half a step away without moving my eyes.

lines.zh: 碰到我的地方会发凉，然后发麻。
lines.en: Where you touch me it goes cold, then numb.

lines.zh: 你推我，我顺着水滑了出去。
lines.en: You shoved me, and I slid away with the water.

lines.zh: 我不硬，撞起来像撞到一整团胶。
lines.en: I am not hard; hitting me feels like hitting glue.

lines.zh: 我的身体会黏住你的武器。
lines.en: My body will stick firmly to your weapon.

lines.zh: 你退开时，黏液拉出一条长丝。
lines.en: As you pull away, the slime stretches into a thread.

lines.zh: 我这层皮不厚，下面全是黏液。
lines.en: My hide is thin; beneath it is all slime.

lines.zh: 别用拳头，黏上就甩不掉。
lines.en: Do not use fists; once stuck, you cannot shake it off.

lines.zh: 我们成对时，眼睛会轮流值守。
lines.en: When paired, my eyes take turns keeping watch.

lines.zh: 她的眼睛比我少两只，但看得准。
lines.en: She has two fewer eyes than I, but sees true.

lines.zh: 我们在礁石背面贴在一起，很安静。
lines.en: We press together behind the reef, very quietly.

lines.zh: 卵会黏在石头上，不好找。
lines.en: The eggs stick to stone and are hard to find.

lines.zh: 成对之后，我游得没那么急了。
lines.en: After pairing, I swim with less urgency.

lines.zh: 你靠近我们的卵，会被两只一起看。
lines.en: Come near our eggs and two of us will watch.

lines.zh: 我们不追同一个目标，会分头。
lines.en: We do not chase the same target; we split up.

lines.zh: 我的黏液也会涂在她身上。
lines.en: My slime ends up on her hide too.

lines.zh: 找伴的时候，眼睛比牙更有用。
lines.en: In finding a mate, eyes are more useful than teeth.

lines.zh: 雷雨里我们才凑到一起。
lines.en: We only come together during thunderstorms.

lines.zh: 我的黏液会把东西粘在身上。
lines.en: My slime glues loose things right onto me.

lines.zh: 你掉的箭，我沾了一根在背上。
lines.en: One of your arrows is stuck to my back.

lines.zh: 我不想要，是它自己黏上来的。
lines.en: I did not want it; it stuck on by itself.

lines.zh: 我捡东西靠粘，不靠手。
lines.en: I collect things by sticking, not by hand.

lines.zh: 海底的破烂都粘在我脚上。
lines.en: Seabed junk clings to my feet as I go.

lines.zh: 你丢的钥匙沉下来，粘住了。
lines.en: The key you dropped sank and stuck to me.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩，甩不掉那枚硬币。
lines.en: I shook myself but could not lose that coin.

lines.zh: 粘在身上的东西，我一般不看。
lines.en: I generally do not look at what sticks to me.

lines.zh: 要拿回去，你得先把手弄湿。
lines.en: To take it back, you will have to wet your hands.

lines.zh: 我身上粘着一层海草和骨片。
lines.en: A crust of seaweed and bone bits sticks to me.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，这就够了，不用别的。
lines.en: I have seen you; that is enough, nothing more needed.

lines.zh: 你站在雷雨的海边，我一眼就挑中。
lines.en: You stood by the sea in the storm; I picked you.

lines.zh: 我不选最弱的，我选最好看的那个。
lines.en: I do not pick the weakest; I pick the best to look at.

lines.zh: 你身上有光，深水里很显眼。
lines.en: There is light on you, very obvious in deep water.

lines.zh: 我锁定你以后，会一直看着你动。
lines.en: Once I mark you, I watch you move without pause.

lines.zh: 你在水里转身，我看见你脸朝哪边。
lines.en: You turn in the water; I see where your face goes.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛不会跟丢，你放心跑。
lines.en: My eyes will not lose you; run as you like.

lines.zh: 目标定了，雷声停了也不会改。
lines.en: The target is set; thunder stopping changes nothing.

lines.zh: 我先看你手里的东西，再看你的脸。
lines.en: I look at what you hold first, then at your face.

lines.zh: 你今天下水，正好进了我的视线。
lines.en: You entered the water today, straight into my sight.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，因为我看得见你在慌。
lines.en: I come slowly because I can see you panicking.

lines.zh: 你在礁石间绕，我的眼睛一直贴着。
lines.en: You weave among the rocks and my eyes stay on you.

lines.zh: 我不出声，出声你就知道我在哪。
lines.en: I make no sound; sound would tell you where I am.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸变快了，我看得出来。
lines.en: Your breathing quickened, and I can tell clearly.

lines.zh: 我在等你的灯油烧完。
lines.en: I am waiting for your lamp oil to run out.

lines.zh: 你藏到石头后面，我换了个角度。
lines.en: You hid behind stone, so I changed my angle.

lines.zh: 我一步一步滑过去，黏液先到。
lines.en: I slide closer step by step, my slime arriving first.

lines.zh: 你游得越急，反而越容易撞上我。
lines.en: The more frantic you swim, the more you hit me.

lines.zh: 我把几只眼闭上，专留两只盯你。
lines.en: I close several eyes and keep two fixed on you.

lines.zh: 你抬头看光源，那是我眼睛的反光。
lines.en: You looked up at a light; it was my eyes reflecting.

lines.zh: 我用牙，也用黏液，先粘再咬。
lines.en: I use teeth and slime: stick first, then bite.

lines.zh: 咬住你，我不急着松口。
lines.en: Once I bite you, I am in no hurry to let go.

lines.zh: 我的牙细，但很多，一排一排。
lines.en: My teeth are small but many, in rows and rows.

lines.zh: 这一下留了个黏糊糊的伤口。
lines.en: This blow leaves a sticky, clinging wound.

lines.zh: 你拽不掉我，黏液已经干了。
lines.en: You cannot pull me off; the slime has dried.

lines.zh: 我咬的时候眼睛仍然看着你的脸。
lines.en: Even while biting, my eyes stay on your face.

lines.zh: 你的血和我的黏液混在一起。
lines.en: Your blood mixes with my slime.

lines.zh: 我咬一次就退，然后从另一侧来。
lines.en: I bite once, retreat, and come from the other side.

lines.zh: 伤口会发麻，那是黏液进了血。
lines.en: The wound goes numb; the slime is in your blood.

lines.zh: 我看准了才动，从不乱咬。
lines.en: I strike only when I see clearly, never wildly.

lines.zh: 雷雨天海里一亮，我就被看见了。
lines.en: In a storm the sea brightens, and I am seen.

lines.zh: 我生在有雷的海洋里，别处没有。
lines.en: I am born in oceans with thunder, nowhere else.

lines.zh: 雨点落下来，把我的眼睛打醒。
lines.en: Rain falls and wakes my eyes one by one.

lines.zh: 云一黑，我就从深处浮上来。
lines.en: The clouds darken and I rise from the deep.

lines.zh: 晴天的浅海不会有我，你放心。
lines.en: No me in sunny shallows; you can relax.

lines.zh: 闪电照亮海底的时候，我睁开了眼。
lines.en: When lightning lit the seabed, I opened my eyes.

lines.zh: 风暴把海水搅浑，我正好借着浑水。
lines.en: The storm muddies the water, and I use the murk.

lines.zh: 每次雷雨，海沟里会多几双眼睛。
lines.en: Each thunderstorm adds a few more eyes to the trench.

lines.zh: 我从卵里出来就会看，不用教。
lines.en: I can see the moment I hatch; nobody teaches me.

lines.zh: 你要找我，等下一场暴雨。
lines.en: If you want to find me, wait for the next downpour.

lines.zh: 火烤干我的黏液，皮就发紧。
lines.en: Fire dries my slime and my hide tightens.

lines.zh: 我摔在礁石上，眼睛花了一片。
lines.en: I land on the reef and my vision splinters.

lines.zh: 我本来就住在水里，不怕水。
lines.en: I already live in water; it does not frighten me.

lines.zh: 爆炸把黏液震飞，我露出皮。
lines.en: The blast blows my slime off and exposes my hide.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我眼睛旁边，偏了一点。
lines.en: The arrow lands beside an eye, slightly off.

lines.zh: 药水一照，我的眼睛全花了。
lines.en: Potion light hits and all my eyes blur.

lines.zh: 我饿着也看，看得更仔细。
lines.en: Hungry, I watch even more carefully than before.

lines.zh: 雷光把我的眼睛全点亮了。
lines.en: Lightning lights up every eye I have.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有影，我照样看得见。
lines.en: No shadows in the void, yet I still see.
